summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K on August 28, 2026, reporting its subsidiary's issuance of a CRE CLO. The issuer, FCR 2026-FL1 Issuer LLC, sold nine classes of notes, including $528.75M Class A and other secured notes plus $67.5M Income Notes, under an indenture. Wilmington Trust serves as trustee, and a company subsidiary acts as collateral manager. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. There is no change of control, shareholder vote, or strategic event. The filing includes the indenture as an exhibit and reports the creation of a direct financial obligation. No deal terms apply.
